assessments.reasoning: Authenticity rests on spdx_detail from spdx/license-list-data at 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. Integrity rests on matching reported digests for [16343,16366), [16293,16340), [4,35) and [16636,16718). Relevance is direct: these give licenseId CC0-1.0, name Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal, isDeprecatedLicenseId false and seeAlso https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode, respectively. Interpretation is documentary identification and referral. Applicability follows from the exact json/details/CC0-1.0.json path at the data tag's target. The contradiction check found the identical ID, name and URL in spdx_xml [99,337) and the matching publisher namespace in publisher_readme [4999,5294).

Authenticity rests on Creative Commons' pinned publisher_readme. Integrity rests on the matching [4999,5294) range digest. Relevance follows from the publisher's own title and canonical URL for the referent. Interpretation uses the README's edition fields to identify the tool independently of SPDX's longer name. Applicability follows because SPDX's legalcode URL extends that exact canonical zero/1.0/ namespace and publisher_live supplies its English legalcode.txt. The contradiction check compared publisher_pin [0,48) and its operative body against the mark and summary alternatives. The publisher evidence identifies the dedication's legal code.

Authenticity follows from spdx_xml at spdx/license-list-XML commit b1dbeb5c8bca21af860a90e187f71d60b84a7a40. Integrity follows from the matching [99,337) digest. Relevance follows from the license element and its crossRef. Interpretation reads licenseId CC0-1.0, name Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal and crossRef https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode as source fields. Applicability follows because src/CC0-1.0.xml is at the XML tag target used by the generator. The contradiction check compared all three values directly with spdx_detail's licenseId, name and seeAlso at the separate data pin. Each agrees exactly.

Authenticity rests on the SPDX data repository's GitHub tag-object response spdx_data_tag for 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b. Integrity rests on the matching whole-response [0,700) digest. Relevance follows from tag v3.29.0 and its release annotation. Interpretation follows object.type commit and object.sha 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, distinct from the tag object's own SHA. Applicability follows because the target equals the revision in spdx_detail's URL. The contradiction check found the same full SHA in spdx_generation and its prefix at the new end of the job push [78398,78461).

Authenticity rests on the SPDX XML repository's GitHub tag-object response spdx_xml_tag for 7523cc3daa7149e35e2debd7466c1dcb14a84e19. Integrity rests on the matching whole-response [0,698) digest. Relevance follows from the v3.29.0 tag and version 3.29.0 annotation. Interpretation follows its commit target b1dbeb5c8bca21af860a90e187f71d60b84a7a40. Applicability follows because that target is the revision in spdx_xml's URL. The contradiction check found the same full SHA in the job's checked-out HEAD [12464,12534). The data tag names the same release in its own repository.

Authenticity rests on spdx_generation from the data repository's Git commit endpoint. Integrity follows from its matching whole-response [0,1237) digest. Relevance follows from the message “License list build 3.29.0 using license list publisher 3.1.4”. Interpretation identifies 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 as that build commit and 3027e0ce357ad6290902c4b57a677fc3b55051b9 as its sole parent. Applicability follows because spdx_data_tag targets that full commit and spdx_detail is pinned there. The contradiction check matched the job's commit message and 31ba1a5 prefix [78070,78175), and both ends of 3027e0c..31ba1a5 [78398,78461).

Authenticity rests on spdx_release_job from the SPDX XML repository's authenticated GitHub Actions job-log endpoint for job 104892289184. Integrity rests on the reported original-body SHA-256 1e9137b29385a9ce0deaa48c20ab9927916426819a69f0cfc6281d239340c282 and the six separately reported range digests matching the citations. Relevance follows from the actual fetch of b1dbeb5c8bca21af860a90e187f71d60b84a7a40 into refs/tags/v3.29.0 [10328,10526), checkout of that ref [11093,11190), and git log command and full SHA result [12394,12464) and [12464,12534). Interpretation follows the observed data-directory cleanup, generator invocation on src for version 3.29.0 using publisher 3.1.4, generated commit 31ba1a5 [78070,78175) and data-repository main push 3027e0c..31ba1a5 [78398,78461). Applicability follows from the inspected src XML at that HEAD and the inspected details JSON at the resulting full data commit. The contradiction check matched the source SHA to spdx_xml_tag, the destination prefix to spdx_data_tag and spdx_generation, and the push predecessor and build message to spdx_generation. The ranges select evidence from this one original log.

challenge.method: Compared XML attributes and crossRef directly against JSON fields, checked the publisher's edition separately, and tested whether matching tag names alone could conceal different revisions or an unrelated build. Compared the observed checkout SHA, generated commit prefix, preceding push prefix and build message with the original Git objects.
challenge.results: All three documentary fields agree. The XML tag targets the checked-out source commit. The data tag targets the generated JSON's commit, whose message matches the job and whose sole parent matches the old end of the push. These observations identify a specific generation event beyond the shared release label.

limitations: This crosswalk describes the SPDX record at the specified revision. It establishes neither representation equivalence nor copyright status or a grant for a particular project.
The SPDX XML, generated details and corresponding tag and build records share information lineage. The latter records support release attribution. Both tags and the generated commit are unsigned.
The job establishes historical generation for the bounded record. A complete bit-for-bit reproduction would require independently rebuilding and comparing outputs.
The tool reported the 81,691-byte original job body. The displayed middle was truncated. All six cited ranges and the generator invocation were available for inspection.
reasoning: The pinned generated JSON pairs CC0-1.0 with “Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal” and points to the publisher's zero/1.0/legalcode. The separately pinned XML contains the same identifier, name and legal-code URL. Creative Commons independently identifies the instrument at that namespace. The two annotated tags bind v3.29.0 to the exact source and data commits inspected. The job's checkout, generator invocation, commit and push connect those revisions in the release build.
